title: Average age of people moving to Sarasota County
text:
This plot estimates the average age of people who moved to Sarasota County from another county, state, or country. ACS reports age in groups, so each group is represented by its midpoint; the 75-and-over group is represented by age 80.

library(tidycensus)
library(dplyr)


Attaching package: 'dplyr'


The following objects are masked from 'package:stats':

    filter, lag


The following objects are masked from 'package:base':

    intersect, setdiff, setequal, union

library(ggplot2)

mover_age_midpoints <- tibble(
  variable = sprintf("B07001_%03dE", c(50:64, 66:80, 82:96)),
  age_midpoint = rep(
    c(2.5, 11, 18.5, 22, 27, 32, 37, 42, 47, 52, 57, 62, 67, 72, 80),
    times = 3
  )
)

sarasota_movers <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  state = "FL",
  county = "Sarasota",
  table = "B07001",
  year = 2024
)

Getting data from the 2020-2024 5-year ACS

sarasota_average_age <- sarasota_movers |>
  filter(variable %in% mover_age_midpoints$variable) |>
  left_join(mover_age_midpoints, by = "variable") |>
  group_by(NAME) |>
  summarise(
    average_age = weighted.mean(age_midpoint, estimate),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(sarasota_average_age, aes(x = NAME, y = average_age)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(average_age, 1)), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Estimated average age of people moving to Sarasota County",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Estimated average age (years)",
    caption = "2024 ACS 5-year estimates. Ages are estimated from age-group midpoints; 75+ is assigned age 80."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
